test_cases.claim_text: Did Trump Tweet That If 'Dow Joans' Tanked, the President Should Be Shot Out of a Cannon?

evidence_item.retrieved_text: On 5 February 2018, Shaun Usher, the owner of the blog "Letters of Note" posted an image on Twitter that purported to show Donald Trump opining that any president presiding over the United States during a stock market crash of more than 1,000 points should be "shot out of a cannon."
